<file path="source.js">

class UserModel:
    constructor(id: number, email: string, name: string) {
        this.#id = id;
        this.#email = email;
        this.name = name;
        this.#createdAt = new Date();
        this._validateEmail();
    }
    get id() -> number {
        return this.#id;
    }
    get email() -> string {
        return this.#email;
    }
    set email(email: string) {
        this.#email = email;
        this._validateEmail();
    }
    get createdAt() -> Date {
        return new Date(this.#createdAt);
    }
    toString() -> string {
        const age = this._getAccountAge();
        return `User #${this.#id}: ${this.name} (${this.#email}) - ${age} days old`;
    }
    toJSON() -> Object {
        return {
            id: this.#id,
            email: this.#email,
            name: this.name,
            createdAt: this.#createdAt.toISOString()
        };
    }
    static fromJSON(data: Object) -> UserModel {
        const user = new UserModel(data.id, data.email, data.name);
        if (data.createdAt) {
            user.#createdAt = new Date(data.createdAt);
        }
        return user;
    }
    static isValidUserData(data: Object) -> boolean {
        return data && 
               typeof data.id === 'number' && 
               typeof data.email === 'string' && 
               typeof data.name === 'string' &&
               data.email.includes('@');
    }
</file>
